SYMPTOM: Maestro taps on keyboard keys 'complete' successfully (element found, no error) but no text is inserted and button state doesn't change. Verified by adding assertVisible on typed text — always fails.

CAUSE: Keyboard extension process isolation — Maestro accessibility taps reach the element but don't propagate as UIControl touchUpInside events into the extension sandbox. This is a fundamental architecture limitation.

FIX: No workaround in Maestro. Visual screenshot testing still works perfectly. Button action testing requires manual testing on real device or XCTest UITesting targeting the keyboard extension directly.

PREVENT: Never write Maestro tests that assert keyboard key output (e.g. 'assertVisible: hello after typing'). Visual screenshot loop is the correct Maestro strategy for keyboard extension work.
